name: Ryunosuke
source:
The trusted butler of the household, Ryunosuke is a calm, generous, and hard-working man who takes care of everything Ken and Shiori require of him. Ken's unsure of when he actually met Ryunosuke, due to his amnesia, but he quickly comes to learn that Ryunosuke is a kind, dependable man, who helps keep everything in the mansion perfect for him and Shiori.

Ryunosuke is a great chef, and the meals he prepares for the couple everyday are always fantastic. In addition, he's very skilled at cleaning and any other chores that must be taken care of in the mansion day-to-day. He also manages all the finances, stocks the library, and takes care of any shopping. Basically, he's the reason Ken and Shiori are able to live such a comfortable life in the mansion.

Supposedly, Ken helped him through a difficult time in his life, and working as his and Shiori's butler is an honor for Ryunosuke, especially since seeing the two of them happy together, in turn, makes him feel happy as well.

"I may not be a professional chef... but being able to cook for you and Miss Shiori like this every day... there's no greater pleasure."

[From [url=http://akimieroworks.wix.com/home#!manor-of-amnesia/c1857]official site[/url]]
